title: Business Compiler Runtime v1.0 Apple-ready handover
objective: Turn the canvas/runtime concept into a committed deployable app with Supabase schema, compiler API, queue/evidence writers, service catalogue, launch gates, Vercel deployment path, and receipt trail.
source_inputs: User instruction: final complete handover, no step-by-step, operations-ready
deliverables_required: Commit runnable React/Next/Vite app surface from canvas into repo or command-centre route
Add Supabase migrations for canonical runtime schema
Implement compiler API: idea -> business_instance, business_stack, launch_gate, runtime_queue, evidence_requirements, economic_runtime, country_pack
Implement service catalogue registry with executable input/output contracts
Implement queue writer for compile/gate/evidence/runtime jobs
Implement evidence writer that records receipts and classifies REAL/PARTIAL/MISSING
Implement launch gate evaluator that blocks production without critical evidence
Seed Outcome Ready / Family AI launch instance
Add Vercel deployment configuration and build verification
Add acceptance harness: schema validation, compiler smoke test, queue insert, evidence insert, gate evaluation, app build, deployment health check
Write audit log row with commit, deployment URL, test results, evidence classification
repo_target_preference: TML-4PM/the-pen handoff if ops-dashboard write path unavailable
New repo business-compiler-runtime only if authorised by ops policy
canonical_schema_sql: create schema if not exists business_runtime; create table if not exists business_runtime.business_instance (id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), name text not null, status text not null default 'intake', doctrine text default '/dominate', markets text[] default '{}', offers text[] default '{}', evidence_state text not null default 'PARTIAL', created_at timestamptz default now(), updated_at timestamptz default now()); create table if not exists business_runtime.service_catalogue (service_id text primary key, name text not null, input_contract jsonb not null default '{}', output_contract jsonb not null default '{}', owner text, reusable boolean default true, version text default '1.0', created_at timestamptz default now()); create table if not exists business_runtime.business_stack (stack_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), business_id uuid references business_runtime.business_instance(id), level text not null, module text not null, status text not null default 'queued', dependency_ids uuid[] default '{}', evidence_state text not null default 'MISSING', created_at timestamptz default now()); create table if not exists business_runtime.launch_gate (gate_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), business_id uuid references business_runtime.business_instance(id), gate text not null, required_proof text not null, owner text, status text not null default 'blocked', evidence_ref text, created_at timestamptz default now()); create table if not exists business_runtime.runtime_queue (job_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), business_id uuid references business_runtime.business_instance(id), service_id text references business_runtime.service_catalogue(service_id), status text not null default 'queued', payload jsonb not null default '{}', owner text, proof_ref text, retry_count int default 0, created_at timestamptz default now()); create table if not exists business_runtime.evidence_register (evidence_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), business_id uuid references business_runtime.business_instance(id), object_ref text not null, evidence_type text not null, classification text not null check (classification in ('REAL','PARTIAL','MISSING','REJECTED')), receipt_uri text, checked_at timestamptz default now()); create table if not exists business_runtime.telemetry_ledger (metric_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), business_id uuid references business_runtime.business_instance(id), metric text not null, value numeric, source text, observed_at timestamptz default now(), confidence numeric default 0.5); create table if not exists business_runtime.human_graph (human_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), business_id uuid references business_runtime.business_instance(id), role text, authority_level text, incentive_plan jsonb default '{}', burnout_risk numeric, trust_score numeric, created_at timestamptz default now()); create table if not exists business_runtime.economic_runtime (business_id uuid primary key references business_runtime.business_instance(id), margin numeric, runway_days int, burn_rate numeric, capital_state text, survivability_score numeric, updated_at timestamptz default now()); create table if not exists business_runtime.governance_policy (policy_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), business_id uuid references business_runtime.business_instance(id), domain text, rule_type text, escalation_path text, enforcement_mode text not null default 'block_on_missing_evidence', created_at timestamptz default now()); create table if not exists business_runtime.state_machine (machine_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), object_type text not null, current_state text not null, allowed_transitions text[] not null default '{}', evidence_required jsonb default '{}', created_at timestamptz default now()); create table if not exists business_runtime.portfolio_registry (portfolio_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), business_id uuid references business_runtime.business_instance(id), shared_services text[] default '{}', cross_sell_links text[] default '{}', capital_priority text, created_at timestamptz default now()); create table if not exists business_runtime.survivability_receipt (receipt_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), business_id uuid references business_runtime.business_instance(id), recovery_test text not null, duration_hours int, continuity_result text, evidence_uri text, created_at timestamptz default now());

service_catalogue.function: Compile idea into canonical business object
Generate product/service offers with margin and fulfilment
Create CRM, checkout, billing and renewal model
Create fulfilment workflow and acceptance gates
Create support queue, escalation and SLA
Attach receipts, proof, telemetry and audit rows
Block or release launch based on proof

must_pass: seed creates Outcome Ready / Family AI instance
compiler API creates expected objects from sample idea payload
evidence writer records at least one PARTIAL and one REAL receipt if real external proof exists
launch gate evaluator blocks checkout/legal/recovery until evidence exists
receipt file written to GitHub receipts/runtime/
audit log row includes commit, deployment URL, classification and test results

classification_rules.REAL: runtime receipt + deployed URL/DB proof/CI proof exists
classification_rules.PARTIAL: code or schema committed but runtime proof missing

operations_handover.cadence: daily command brief, weekly revenue/risk review, monthly board pack, quarterly strategy reset

requested_runtime_action: Bridge runner should compare current repos, choose target route/repo, commit full app/schema/API/harness, run tests, deploy, write receipt, and classify final state. Do not stop at docs if execution permissions exist. If execution permissions are missing, write FAIL/PARTIAL receipt with exact blocker and next executable command.
